items.title: Encrypted Audio
items.summary: Mobile audio player for encrypted content, built as a freelance project. Includes a user app for playback and an admin app for uploading and managing audio files.
items.bodyText: This is a project about an audio player with encrypted data to play. I built two mobile applications as a freelance project: a user app and an admin app. Both are built with React Native. Overview Role: Front End Programmer Type: Mobile Apps (User and Admin) Technology: React Native Release: Features: Download and audio playback controls (play/pause/seek) Encryption/decryption flow for protected audio content Admin app to upload and delete encrypted audio data Role I collaborated with a backend engineer. As the front end programmer, I implemented and maintained the features for both the user and admin mobile apps. Footage Video footage:

items.title: General Admin Template

items.bodyText: This project demonstrates my experience building an admin dashboard, based on work I did as part of the team. It uses a Bootstrap based template and vanilla JavaScript for practical, easy to extend UI patterns. Overview Role: Developer Type: Web App, REST API Technology: Backend: Express.js MongoDB Frontend: Bootstrap admin template: jQuery DataTables Parsley.js Font Awesome Summernote Repo: Features: Demo data and sample admin screens Work in progress enhancements Role I built this project as a portfolio demo and learning sandbox for admin dashboard patterns.
